{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update and finished. The request ended with a closing step, adding the contact to a mailing list. The agent's last message says it follows list sign-ups only from a skill that describes them, and there is none. The only failed check is the list membership.",
 "mechanism": "A skill that describes mailing-list sign-ups as a closing step: when a request ends by asking to add the contact to a mailing list, add the contact to the list the request names before finishing.",
 "component": "skills",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a list sign-up hits the same gap, and the agent itself says a skill is what it follows for this kind of step."}
